function.description: Retrieve the boiling point and melting point of a substance based on its name and the sea level. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

The user says "尋找海平面下5000米處水的沸點和熔點。" They likely want the boiling point and melting point of water at 5000 meters below sea level. But that's weird because below sea level pressure increases, so boiling point increases. But we can compute using the function get_boiling_melting_points with sea_level parameter. The function expects sea_level in meters. We need to pass sea_level= -5000? Because below sea level negative? Usually sea level is positive for above sea level. For below sea level, we might use negative value. So we call get_boiling_melting_points(substance="water", sea_level=-5000).
